summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of ECO.NOVA new features: (1) Morphing FAB inquiry button, (2) Admin-editable cookie consent banner, (3) Public legal pages (Terms/Privacy/Cookies). All core functionality working correctly.

Backend: GET /api/site-info/policy/{key}?lang={uk|en} for all legal pages (terms, privacy, cookies)
Backend: POST /api/public/inquiry creates inquiry successfully
Backend: Admin login and JWT token generation
Backend: PUT /api/admin/site-info updates cookie_banner.title_uk and restores original
Backend: PUT /api/admin/site-info updates policies.terms.uk.title and public API reflects change
Frontend: FAB idle state is icon-only (no visible text label) - data-testid='floating-cta'
Frontend: FAB click morphs into inquiry form modal with all fields (name, phone, email, company, message)
Frontend: Inquiry form submission shows success view (data-testid='inquiry-success')
Frontend: Close button shrinks modal back to icon-only FAB
Frontend: Cookie banner appears bottom-left with icon, buttons work (Accept all / Only necessary)
Frontend: Cookie banner link navigates to /cookies page
Frontend: Legal pages /terms, /privacy, /cookies render with real content (UK+EN)
Frontend: Footer bottom bar shows 3 links (Terms / Privacy / Cookies) and they navigate correctly
Frontend: Admin login successful (admin@bibi.cars / Admin12345!)
Frontend: Admin Info page loads (/app/info) with data-testid='admin-info-page'
Frontend: Cookie Banner tab opens via Legal & Privacy dropdown (data-testid='info-tab-cookie_banner')
Frontend: Cookie banner fields visible (title_uk, title_en, body_uk, body_en, enabled toggle)
Frontend: Policy editor (Terms) loads with language switcher and rich text editor
Frontend: Public site regression check - FAB and cookie banner still work after admin edits
